name: 6 Must-Try Animated UI Component Libraries for React
summary: Guide to six open-source animated React UI component libraries: Shadcn Space, Magic UI, React Bits, Hero UI, Kokonut UI and Animate UI.
description: A blog guide reviewing six animated React component libraries, with a comparison table of GitHub stars and component counts (50+ to 210+ components), the core stack most of them share — React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Framer Motion — and an FAQ on copy-paste components, SaaS dashboards and animation performance. Written for React developers choosing an animation library.
